## If this adds or changes a recipe

Recipes run as root on people's machines, so please be exact here.

- **Distro and version you tested:**
- **Hardware you booted it on** (not a virtual machine):
- **What worked:** boots to a login screen / desktop / live session
- **What you did not test:**
- [ ] The recipe's `# tested:` line says the same as the above
- [ ] The recipe does not use the network and touches nothing outside `$M`
- [ ] It is safe to run twice ("Repair boot")
- [ ] I added or updated the entry in `RECIPES.md`
